title: POST /api/projects/:id/github/connect — link GitHub repo to project
description: Allow users to link a specific GitHub repository to a project. Triggers initial import of commits and releases.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Requires user to have github_access_token set (return 400 if not)
Fetches available repos from GitHub API to validate the repo exists and user has access
Stores github_repo_id and github_repo_name on the project
Triggers background import of last 90 days of commits (non-blocking)

steps.details: npm install @octokit/rest. This is the official GitHub API client.

Create server/src/services/githubService.ts. Export function getOctokit(encryptedToken: string): Octokit — decrypt token, return new Octokit({ auth: decryptedToken }). Export async function getRepo(octokit, owner, repo): Promise<RepoData>. Export async function importCommits(projectId, octokit, owner, repo): Promise<void>.

Create server/src/routes/github.ts. POST /connect: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Fetch user — check github_access_token exists. 3) Decrypt token, get Octokit instance. 4) Call octokit.repos.get({ owner, repo }) — if 404, return 400 'Repo not found or no access'. 5) Update project: github_repo_id = repo.id, github_repo_name = 'owner/repo'. 6) Fire and forget: importCommitsForProject(projectId, octokit, owner, repo). 7) Return 200 { repoName: 'owner/repo', importStatus: 'importing' }.
Connect GitHub account (TASK-56). Link a real public repo. Verify project has github_repo_name set. Wait 5 seconds, check github_commits table — verify commits imported.
